content:
New article published in SANDRP.

The piece explores how communities in the Kosi floodplains of Bihar experience and respond to water insecurity. Based on field research, it argues that water security is not only about access to water but also about the capacity to adapt to floods, shifting river channels, and hydrological uncertainty.
